review.item_premise: Only public proposed causes, checked schedule and explicit numeric limits enter. Candidate compilation retains its authority discriminator. Final gate evidence carries exact debits, certified stamps and output-only headroom; refusal mutates no caller state. No authentication or persistent write follows. Capacity is checked while constructing the candidate, before admission can consume it.
